snapshot.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments. [1]

narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: H1 FY26 sales were 1579.0 and H2 FY26 sales were 2047.0, representing an increase of roughly 29.6%, falling short of the 50-60% promise.

promises.credibility: Management shows high ambition with long-term targets like $1 billion by FY28, but shorter-term volume growth promises have fallen short of their aggressive targets.

bull: Revenue grew 41% YoY in the latest quarter of Jun 2026 with an operating profit margin of 16%.
Profit outgrew revenue over 3 years, showing a PAT CAGR of 56% compared to revenue CAGR of 48%.
The company maintains a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.19, increasing slightly from 0.16 three periods ago.
bear: PAT declined by 25% YoY in the latest quarter of Jun 2026 while margins dropped by 1.1pp YoY to 15.6%.
Working capital is stretching significantly as the cash conversion cycle lengthened from 123 to 193 days.
Free cash flow was negative in 5 of 5 years, totaling ₹-3,288 Cr cumulatively over the period.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence of positive free cash flow and normalization of debtor days.
